procedure_signature.notes: Batch 4G skill 4/5. Scope Operator-derived. The tightest-boundary skill in the chain: extracts the numeric GLOBAL maximum bending moment from a GIVEN finished diagram, consuming shear_moment_diagram_construction (skill 3) as input rather than re-constructing it. Owns exactly the sliver skill 3 ceded. Principle: interior M extrema at V=0 (dM/dx=V, cited from skill 2), but the GLOBAL max is the largest |M| among ALL candidates - all V=0 stations plus supports, free ends, and concentrated-couple discontinuities - including hogging (negative) moments. Worked example Operator-re-derived: overhang beam 12 m (pin A@0, roller B@8, free C@12), w=4 throughout, Ay=12/By=36 (reactions checked: ByX8 = 48X6). Diagram given and self-consistent: V(0+)=12, V=0 at x=3, V(8-)=-20, jump to V(8+)=+16, V=0 at free end x=12; M(3)=+18 sagging, M(8)=-32 hogging (M(8)=18 - (1/2)(5)(20) = -32), M closes to 0 at the free end. Candidates compared by magnitude: |M(3)|=18 vs |M(8)|=32 -> GLOBAL MAX = -32 kN·m hogging at x=8 (support B). The first V=0 station (x=3, +18) is deliberately NOT the answer - the overhang produces a larger hogging support moment, so the >=2-candidate comparison and the include-hogging rule genuinely bite (a single-hump SS beam would not exercise the skill). TWO-signal mapping: sign_or_placement_error at step 5 (selecting the wrong candidate - first V=0 over the larger hogging, or a max-|V| station - or mis-signing the winner), unclassified at step 6 (checking one candidate, reconstructing the diagram, straying into stress). solution_sequencing_error OMITTED: the diagram is given as input, so no authored step strands a prerequisite the way skill 3's reactions->V->M construction gate did - the signal is placed by error model, and here the input framing removes the strand. This completes the batch's sequencing-signal pattern: earned on frame_machine_equilibrium (member coupling) and shear_moment_diagram_construction (construction order), declined on the single-cut and given-diagram skills. axis_confusion omitted (no component resolution). simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). Serial-chain leaf: unlocks no further node.

Batch 4G skill 3/5. Scope Operator-derived. The synthesis skill: constructs the COMPLETE shear and moment diagrams across the whole beam by TRAVERSING with the load-shear-moment relations (from shear_moment_load_relationships, skill 2), not by re-solving section equilibrium at many cuts. Consumes the point-value siblings (shear/bending at a cut) and the relations node. Boundary: skill 2 supplies the relations (dV/dx=-w, dM/dx=V, areas, jumps, degrees) - cited, not re-derived; the single-cut skills give values consistent with the diagram at a cut but are not the construction method; maximum_moment_from_zero_shear (skill 4, downstream) specializes in extracting the numeric GLOBAL-MAX moment - this skill builds the diagram and labels the V=0 peak value but does NOT reframe the deliverable as global-max extraction. Worked example Operator-re-derived, same SS 6 m/w=4/Ay=By=12 family: V by traversal - jump +12 at A, V(x)=12-4x, V(3)=0, V(6-)=-12, jump +12 at B -> 0, closes, linear under UDL. M from area under V - M(0)=0, area 0-3 = +(1/2)(3)(12)=18 -> M(3)=18, area 3-6 = -18 -> M(6)=0, closes at the simple support, parabolic under UDL. Peak M=18 kN·m at x=3 where V=0. FOUR-signal mapping: sign_or_placement_error at step 3 (V-jump senses, slope sense, peak placement), solution_sequencing_error at step 4, unclassified at step 7. solution_sequencing_error is GENUINELY EARNED here - the strongest home in the batch: step 4 is a real order-gate, the M diagram is the area under V so building M before the V diagram is determined strands the area-under-V prerequisite (M is mathematically underivable, not merely out of preferred order), and the trigger is evidence-gated on the out-of-order construction, never inferred from a wrong final number. This contrasts with its correct OMISSION on the batch's single-cut skills (frame single-cut siblings, shear, bending-moment, and the relations node), where no authored step stranded a prerequisite; the signal is placed by error model, not recency. axis_confusion omitted (no component-resolution step). simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). Diagrams built by traversal, closure verified (V->0 after last reaction, M=0 at simple ends), degrees correct (parabolic M under UDL). Unlocks maximum_moment_from_zero_shear (skill 4).

Batch 4G skill 2/5. Scope Operator-derived. The load-shear-moment relationship node: owns the differential relations dV/dx = -w and dM/dx = V and their area forms (ΔV = -area under w; ΔM = area under V), plus the consequences (V=0 -> M local extremum; concentrated load -> V jump; couple -> M jump; unloaded span V constant M linear; uniform load V linear M parabolic). Boundary INVERTED from skills 1/shear: bending_moment_internal_loading and shear_force_internal_loading find V and M at ONE cut by section equilibrium and excluded the differential relations; THIS skill owns those relations and cites the siblings for point values. It is NOT the diagrams (shear_moment_diagram_construction, downstream skill 3) and NOT the numeric global max moment (maximum_moment_from_zero_shear, skill 4); both are named and ceded. Worked example Operator-re-derived: 6 m simply-supported beam, uniform w=4 kN/m, Ay=By=12, V(0+)=12. dV/dx = -w = -4 kN/m (the minus is load-bearing: downward w gives decreasing shear; +4 would reverse the sense and misplace the extremum). ΔV = -area under w = -(4)(6) = -24 kN, checked V(6-)=12-24=-12. V(x)=12-4x, V=0 at x=3 m, where dM/dx=V=0 so M has a local extremum - and the example states the extremum is NOT at max|w| or max|V| (which are at the ends), the exact misconception the skill owns. All deliverables are local/span relation applications; no full diagram drawn, no numeric M_max computed. TWO-signal mapping: sign_or_placement_error at step 3 (the dV/dx=-w sign and the V=0 extremum placement - the skill's crux), unclassified at step 6 (the diagram/max-moment boundary). axis_confusion OMITTED: a calculus-relation skill, no component-resolution step. solution_sequencing_error OMITTED although the w->V->M integration has a natural order and this was the batch skill where it could plausibly be earned: considered honestly and declined - no authored step exposes an out-of-order solve that strands a prerequisite unknown with direct evidence; the example applies the relations in order without a sequencing trap. The fifth signal is mapped only where an authored step earns it, not defaulted because integration has an order. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). Unlocks shear_moment_diagram_construction (skill 3).

Batch 4G skill 1/5. Scope Operator-derived. The bending-moment specialization of internal_loading_at_section (the signed parent that finds the full N/V/M trio at a section): this skill owns the internal bending moment M at one cut, the SigmaM=0 about the cut that determines it, the force lever arms about the cut, and the sign convention that makes M signed rather than a magnitude. Shear V at the same cut is owned by the signed sibling shear_force_internal_loading (cited, not re-solved); shear/moment diagrams (shear_moment_diagram_construction, downstream skill 3) and the load-shear-moment relations (shear_moment_load_relationships, downstream skill 2) are excluded; stress/deflection out of scope. Worked example Operator-re-derived, continuous with the shear skill's beam: simply-supported 6 m beam, P=30 kN down at 2 m, reactions Ay=20/By=10 kN given; cut at x=4 m (after the load), left portion SigmaM about the cut (CCW+): M - Ay(4) + P(2) = M - 80 + 60 = 0 -> M = +20 kN·m, sagging under the stated convention. The sign is meaningful, not a bare magnitude: Ay's CCW moment exceeds P's CW moment, netting sagging; a flipped convention or lever-arm sense gives the wrong sign. The cut is placed after the load so the nonzero-lever-arm feature bites - forgetting P gives the wrong M=80; distinguishing-feature-must-bite discipline satisfied. Opposite-segment check closes: right portion By(2)-20 = 20-20 = 0, confirming +20 CCW left face pairs with 20 CW right face. TWO-signal mapping, both content-earned: sign_or_placement_error at step 5 (the SigmaM/sign/lever-arm crux - M is meaningless without its sign), unclassified at step 7 (report/convention/diagram boundary). axis_confusion OMITTED: transverse loads, no component-resolution step. solution_sequencing_error OMITTED although live: single-cut solve with given reactions, no step strands a prerequisite unknown on an out-of-order solve - the fifth signal mapped only where earned, consistent with its omission on shear_force_internal_loading. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). Opens Batch 4G; unlocks shear_moment_load_relationships (skill 2).
